features: Seven connected VM, engine diagnostics, console, trace/repl and inspector modules execute from Home-owned generation.
The VM context, Script, module, SourceTextModule and SyntheticModule native implementations and inspector profiler are rebuilt together with complete header ABI/cache validation.
Twenty selected implementation/header files match the Bun source pin exactly.
limitations: This checkpoint verifies ordinary context/module/profiling and related conformance; broader VM verification remains outstanding.
Pinned inspector lifecycle, tracing and REPL include unfinished behavior; ownership is not credit for implementing those APIs.
Disk-guard refusals receive no test credit. Obsolete native cache outputs were removed only after terminal builds, keeping newest objects and invalidating manifests.
VM per-context memory accounting remains #870; inspector lifecycle remains #428. Full Bun-suite parity and Release/ASAN/all-platform verification remain open under #66.
